issues.where: whole frame background: cliffs, cave mouth and lava falls behind the animals
issues.what: -a has a dark towering cliff on the right and a big glowing lava cascade pouring down the left behind the herd; -b replaces both with a flat grey-pink smoke wall, a pale blocky slab at left with a thin lava trickle, and an empty orange horizon glow
issues.fix: rebuild the massive dark cliff at right and the wide bright lava fall descending left to the plain, with dark smoky air rather than pale grey fog

issues.where: the ground across the whole foreground and midground
issues.what: -a ground is rough, black, rubbly basalt with many glowing cracks, pools and steaming vents; -b is a smooth, clean, lilac-grey plaster-like surface with a few thin cracks and one glowing seam
issues.fix: darken the ground to near-black, add relief, rubble, broken crust and dense glowing cracks and small pools, especially around feet and the feeding mouth; add steam rising off it

issues.what: -a animals are dry, leathery, gaunt and bony with rough weathered skin, splayed legs and stilt-like stances; -b animals are smooth, glossy, segmented with regular ribs, like clean CG models; the near animal's mouth-tendrils are lit but don't light the ground or raise steam the way -a does (in -a the root mouth sits in a glowing lava ring with smoke)
issues.fix: give the bodies rough desiccated hide, irregular bony anatomy and dust; seat the tendril mouth in a glowing pool that lights the legs and kicks up fume; add rim light from the lava on the side facing it

issues.what: -a is low-key, warm amber-brown with deep shadows and lava as the key light; -b is flat, cool lilac-grey with a pinkish band and little contrast, shadows under the animals are weak
issues.fix: lower overall exposure, warm the palette toward brown/amber, raise contrast, and let lava be the dominant light source casting shadows away from it

issues.where: right animal's lifted foot and the near-ground dust
issues.what: -a shows a raised hoof shedding falling debris and a dark rock out-of-focus foreground at lower left; -b has no debris and no foreground rubble
issues.fix: add the soft foreground rock mass at lower left and particulate falling from the lifted foot

issues.where: the lava flow from cave to floor
issues.what: -a has a wide, bright braided lava cascade that spreads into a broad glowing fan across the floor; -b has a single thin lava thread down a pale slope and only a few faint lines at the base
issues.fix: widen and brighten the flow into a braided cascade and a broad glowing delta across the floor, lighting rocks and fume around it

issues.where: the slope below the cave and the cave rim
issues.what: -a slope is dark, broken basalt ledges and scree; -b is a pale, smooth, orange-washed sandlike slope scattered with uniform low-poly boulders, and the cave rim glow is a flat even orange band rather than rock lit from below
issues.fix: make the slope dark rugged layered basalt with natural scree; light the cave arch with graded lava-glow that falls off with distance and reveals rock texture

issues.what: -a shows the rocky cliff on the right with an orange-lit steam plume rising from the lava; -b covers it with a large opaque dark grey smoke mass that hides the landform and isn't lit by the lava
issues.fix: thin the smoke, tint it orange from below where it meets the lava, and let the right-hand cliff read through

issues.where: the two animals at the flow's edge
issues.what: -a has two clear long-legged animals standing at the lava fan, rim-lit; -b has one tiny barely visible figure at far right
issues.fix: restore two animals at the same scale near the lava edge, backlit by the glow

issues.what: -a foreground is dark rough out-of-focus crust with one bright lava crack; -b is a smooth, reflective, bluish-lilac sheet with blurred streaks like a wet floor
issues.fix: make it dark matte rough crust with one defined glowing crack crossing it

issues.what: -a cliff is dark, jagged and textured; -b is a smooth horizontally striated grey wall, lighter and cooler
issues.fix: darken and roughen the cliff, break up the regular stratified banding
